report_name: French Bank Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Hit by Cyberattack Enabling $133M+ Crypto Theft

threat_actors.name: Unidentified Actors in Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Heist
threat_actors.description: Unidentified threat actors who compromised a service provider of Crédit Mutuel Arkéa to facilitate the theft of over $133 million in cryptocurrency. The actors initiated fraudulent wire transfers to cryptocurrency exchanges and laundered the funds.
threat_actors.goals: Financial theft via fraudulent wire transfers and cryptocurrency laundering.

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: The attackers gained initial access by compromising a third-party service provider connected to Crédit Mutuel Arkéa, exploiting the trusted relationship to access the bank's financial systems.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The attackers likely used compromised credentials or systems with authority, gained from the third-party service provider, to initiate fraudulent wire transfers from the bank's corporate account.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over Web Service
attack_patterns.description: The attackers exfiltrated stolen funds by transferring them to accounts at legitimate cryptocurrency exchange web services, including Kraken, Crypto.com, and OKX, where the fiat was converted to cryptocurrency.

attack_patterns.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
attack_patterns.description: The attackers laundered the stolen funds through decentralized exchanges like UniswapX and privacy-enhancing technologies like the Monero cryptocurrency to obscure the on-chain audit trail.

tools.name: Kraken
tools.description: A cryptocurrency exchange where attackers opened accounts under false identities to receive fraudulent fiat transfers and convert them to cryptocurrency.

tools.name: Crypto.com
tools.description: A cryptocurrency exchange where attackers opened accounts under false identities to receive fraudulent fiat transfers and convert them to cryptocurrency.

tools.name: OKX
tools.description: A cryptocurrency exchange where attackers opened accounts under false identities to receive fraudulent fiat transfers and convert them to cryptocurrency.

tools.name: UniswapX
tools.description: A decentralized exchange protocol used by the attackers to swap and launder the stolen stablecoins to complicate tracking.

tools.name: Monero
tools.description: A privacy-enhancing cryptocurrency used by the attackers to launder a portion of the stolen funds and break the on-chain audit trail.

identities.name: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa
identities.description: A French banking group that was the target of a cyberattack, resulting in the theft of over $112 million through fraudulent transactions.

identities.name: ZachXBT
identities.description: An on-chain investigator who first reported and publicly linked the fraudulent transactions to Crédit Mutuel Arkéa.

infrastructure.name: Attacker-Controlled Cryptocurrency Exchange Accounts
infrastructure.description: Accounts set up by the attackers at various cryptocurrency exchanges under false identities to receive fraudulent wire transfers and convert fiat to cryptocurrency.

indicators.name: Anomalous API Activity from Third-Party Service Provider
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous API Activity from Third-Party Service Provider
id: 7e5d8f1a-9c0b-4d2e-8f1a-9c0b4d2e8f1a
status: experimental
description: Detects unusual API calls to or from third-party service providers, especially those with financial transaction capabilities, which could indicate a supply chain compromise.
references:
  - https://shattered.io/zachxbt-credit-mutuel-arkea-133m-crypto-theft-engineering-lessons-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-05
tags:
  - attack.t1199
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    cs-host: 
      - 'service-provider-api.example.com' # Placeholder for actual service provider domains
    c-uri|contains:
      - '/initiate_transfer'
      - '/create_payment'
  filter_known_source:
    c-ip:
      - '1.2.3.4' # Placeholder for known legitimate source IPs
  condition: selection and not filter_known_source
indicators.description: Detects unusual API calls from third-party service provider platforms, especially those with financial transaction capabilities, as seen in the Crédit Mutuel Arkéa attack.

indicators.name: Anomalous Large Fiat to Crypto Exchange Transfers
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Large Fiat to Crypto Exchange Transfers
id: 8b2c4a9d-1e3f-4b5a-8c9d-1e3f4b5a8c9d
status: experimental
description: Detects large, unexpected wire transfers to accounts at known cryptocurrency exchanges, followed by rapid conversion and withdrawal, which is a key TTP from the Crédit Mutuel Arkéa heist.
references:
  - https://shattered.io/zachxbt-credit-mutuel-arkea-133m-crypto-theft-engineering-lessons-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-05
tags:
  - attack.t1567
level: high
logsource:
  category: application
  product: generic
detection:
  selection_transfer:
    event_type: 'wire_transfer_initiated'
    destination_entity_type: 'cryptocurrency_exchange'
    amount_usd|gt: 100000
  selection_conversion:
    event_type: 'fiat_to_crypto_conversion'
    amount_usd|gt: 100000
  timeframe: 1h
  condition: selection_transfer and selection_conversion
indicators.description: Detects patterns indicative of financial theft where large fiat transfers are made to cryptocurrency exchanges and immediately converted, as seen in the Crédit Mutuel Arkéa heist.
